reference.rationale: Fixed before any GPU result: several bf16 roundings, approximate elementary functions and bf16 saved states. Elementwise tolerance AND relative L2 cap required. Must first pass official tied-baseline calibration on the same fixture/dtype for each architecture; triple is INCONCLUSIVE if baseline calibration fails. These caps are never fitted to triple errors or relaxed after failure.

plan.promotion: Never automatic, even if all checks PASS

matched_launch.rule: One supported config from unchanged upstream config list, frozen before measurements; no search or autotuner mutation

drift_matrix.conditional_hybrid: Only if identical-input dqkv replay changes non-ADT outputs; one variant, two full dqkv calls

adapter.cross_length_profile: unchanged reference profile; same padded shape uses structural profile

plan.paired_reference: Each original/candidate/reference triplet uses the same quantized source tensors; tied official calibrated first. Independent triple cannot be called confirmed if tied calibration fails.
plan.angle_advisory: Ideal FP64 PyTorch elementary functions are advisory, separate from arithmetic pair and actual GPU reverse scan
